title: packet-bgp: Support BGP-MUP SAFI and Extended Community
description:
This MR enables Wireshark to support new SAFI and Extended Community for BGP-MUP defined in draft-mpmz-bess-mup-safi-00.
https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-mpmz-bess-mup-safi-00.txt

SAFI value 85 is assigned by IANA as "BGP-MUP SAFI"
https://www.iana.org/assignments/safi-namespace/safi-namespace.xhtml

BGP Transitive Extended Community Types 0x0c is assigned by IANA as "SRv6 MUP Extended Community"
https://www.iana.org/assignments/bgp-extended-communities/bgp-extended-communities.xhtml


Signed-off-by: Yuya Kawakami <yuyarin@yuyarin.net>
